riasecRouteAudit.dashboardHybrid: The request contains S4 as one scalar score, but the selected group RIASEC letters are not passed to calculate_hybrid. The five weights can still make S4 affect a score indirectly; group-specific RIASEC fit is not calculated.
riasecRouteAudit.assessmentHistoryLegacy: career_matching.calculate_matches uses each group RIASEC tuple to derive its group-specific S4 criterion.
riasecRouteAudit.resolution: No matching behavior changed. Reconcile route semantics and approve golden outputs before describing RIASEC as group-specific fit in the dashboard.
